content: Hevy app lifting logger: 400+ exercise library with equipment/muscle filters; logs auto-populate previous set count, weight, and reps when an exercise is repeated; tap checkmark per set to mark complete and trigger rest timer; superset creation via three-dot menu; Smart Superset Scrolling auto-advances to next exercise in circuit on set completion. Social feed (following friends) is polarizing — some love accountability, others find it adds friction. Has grown heavier (more features) over time; speed-focused users sometimes prefer Strong.
